record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, reduce the training-frequency input modulation amplitude from 0.04 to 0.02: use 1 + 0.02*tanh(standardized log1p training item counts). This retains a varying, training-only frequency feature while weakening its influence on context representations. Keep padding and mask scales at 1, and preserve embedding design, topology, readout, loss and optimizer. Save the resulting scales in each category's single checkpoint.
